notes: v260 — NAV-TOP-CUTOFF + NAV-PIXELATED-ROADS + NAV-VIBRANT-COLORS + NAV-NO-UTURN (owner, Mon Oct 26, 2026 07:41 + 07:43 MDT, driving Peigan Trail SE; verdicts from his screen recording). (1) TOP CUTOFF: the defect predates the 50° pitch — a homography of the exact composition (plane 230%x300%, origin 50% 50%, anchor 50%/64%, perspective 1100px) on his real 768x1024 drive screen projects the plane's far edge only ~477px above the anchor against ~655px needed: the top ~15% uncovered at EVERY heading (the dark band under the banner was the viewport sky gradient; the v139/v220 coverage math used a 360x640 reference screen). Growing the plane alone cannot fix side headings (reach bounded by halfW x cos(pitch)), so the posture keeps its exact 50° and planeTransform gains a translateY compensation — lift = 0.49 x live viewport height, set by paintPlane, sim-verified full top coverage at all headings — the plane widens 230% -> 260% (left -80%) for the sampled raster, and the follow camera (tick pan, animator, snap-back, drive-open) centres on the new followTarget (the point ahead by lift/cos(pitch) projected px) so the truck stays glued to its anchor; the lift suspends while a two-finger rotate/tilt owns the view (v215 pivot contract) and pinch is excused from the anchor pan (its zoom-around-the-truck preserves the truck's screen point). (2) PIXELATED ROADS: mechanism proven by live tile probes — the drive view runs zoom 18 while the street layer was capped maxNativeZoom 15 (v232/v235, against Esri's blank fringe tiles), an 8x upscale. Esri is STILL blank at z17/18 over his areas (z18 home 0/9 detailed, z17 3/9) but OpenStreetMap standard serves real detail at native z18 (9/9 home, 8/9 Peigan): the street source returns to OSM at native z18 via spec.maxNative (paintDriveLayers reads it); Esri World Imagery verified real at z18 (18,767 unique colours/tile) so satellite also goes native 18; hillshade stays 15 (soft relief, outside the complaint). (3) VIBRANT COLORS: the street tiles' CSS lift is re-tuned for OSM's paler raw palette (suburb mean saturation 0.052), simulated in PIL on the live tiles before shipping: saturate(2.3) hue-rotate(11deg) contrast(1.16) — suburb 0.052 -> 0.110, Deerfoot/Bow 0.111 -> 0.206; water #a7c6e4 -> #98d1ff (rich blue), park #c8facc -> #8fffbc, trunk #f5ba97 -> #ffbe40 (bold orange), primary #fcd6a4 -> #ffe749 (bold yellow), motorway #e88ea0 -> #ff767e (bold coral-red — the +11deg rotation holds it out of the v124 hot-pink band; +22deg simulated and rejected: water went periwinkle, parks teal). Route line, truck marker, banner, lane inset and chrome unchanged; the drive map underlay warms to #e9e2d0. (4) NO-UTURN: the v135/v192 exclusion layers had a structural hole at the START of a route — excluding the turn-around point just moves it to the next intersection or excludes the origin itself, and after two rounds the sanitized plan's LINE still doubled back. New last layer before sanitize: when the exclusion rounds are spent and an offending maneuver still begins within the first 1 km and a live heading is known, the route is re-asked FORWARD — a 'through' point projected 500 m (then 1200 m) ahead of the truck along its heading (NAVPURE forwardOrigin) plus the heading on the origin location (buildRouteRequest opts.via/opts.heading; the default request shape is byte-identical) — so the answer begins by continuing forward along the current road. A failed forward request retries once plain; sanitizeTruckPlan still guarantees no U-turn is ever spoken or shown. Car mode untouched. Harnesses: new tools/nav-v260-test.js (24 checks: tile contract, forwardOrigin, request shapes, planeTransform strings incl. byte-identical rest string at zero lift, follow wiring, CSS palette pins); navigator-v135 gains section F (11 checks: forward round fires after exclusions, via geometry at 500/1200 m, heading on origin, failed-via plain retry) and its C1 bound re-pins 3 -> 5 fetches (the fixture's U-turn sits ~696 m in — inside the forward layer's reach — and the sanitize net below it is unchanged); the superseded pins in nav-tile-coverage-v232 (source + native zoom) and nav-map-colors-v239 (source, contrast band, native zoom) re-based to the v260 contract on the Oct 26 probe evidence; plane-size pins re-based 230%/-65% -> 260%/-80% in navigator-v139, navigator-v178 (writer pin moved for the lift derivation) and navigator-screen (also its v128 panTo pin now aims at followTarget). All other nav suites at their v259 pass/fail baseline or better. His next real drive is the verdict on all four.
